# awscc_networkflowmonitor_performance_monitor (Resource)

Creates a performance monitor to monitor network performance between a set of targets for a workload.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `monitor_name` (String) The name of the performance monitor.
- `targets` (Attributes List) The targets that are monitored by the performance monitor. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))

### Optional

- `scope_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the scope for the performance monitor.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags for the performance monitor. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the performance monitor.
- `created_at` (String) The date and time when the performance monitor was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `modified_at` (String) The date and time when the performance monitor was last modified.
- `monitor_status` (String) The status of the performance monitor.
- `monitor_type` (String) The type of the performance monitor.

<a id="nestedatt--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets`

Required:

- `identifier` (String) The identifier of the target.
- `type` (String) The type of the target.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_networkflowmonitor_performance_monitor.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the performance monitor

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform

  to = awscc_networkflowmonitor_performance_monitor.example
  id = "arn"

```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
